'; cat /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros2.list

'; gpg --batch --show-keys --with-colons /usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg

OTHER_ROS_KEY
'; gpg --batch --show-keys --with-colons /usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-pro-ros.gpg

'; grep -nEi 'ros|colcon|ament|rmw|dds|setup\.' /home/jetson/.bashrc

ALL_USER_CRON_ROS
'; for u in root jetson; do echo "$u"; crontab -u "$u" -l 2>/dev/null || true; done
printf '
PHOTO_SCRIPT
'; if [ -f /home/jetson/photo.sh ]; then sed -n '1,100p' /home/jetson/photo.sh; fi
printf '
ROS_ORIGIN_UNITS
'; grep -RlE '/opt/ros/|ros2 (run|launch|daemon)|roscore|roslaunch|colcon_ws|photo\.sh' /etc/systemd/system /etc/cron.d /etc/rc.local /etc/xdg/autostart /home/jetson/.config/autostart 2>/dev/null || true
